i run the UDTClientServerConnectionTest in package testsuit, is right , but the test demo is to Verify UDT connect/disconnect life cycle with  UDT Byte Stream mode, no the UDT Message Flow.
and from NioUdtMessageConnectorChannel  source, is Deprecated, and  no longer maintained and will be removed, why remove in netty 4.1.12 ? the #6146 is in 20170120, and SocketUtils was commited , then
netty 4.1.12 was realease in 20170609 ?
 java.lang.AbstractMethodError is cause by the deprecation  ？

This is the same case as the `NioUdtByteConnectorChannel`. `SocketChannelUDT` does not have the java 7 `public abstract SocketChannel bind(SocketAddress local)` method. `NioUdtMessageConnectorChannel` will need the same thing [workaround](https://github.com/netty/netty/blob/4.1/transport-udt/src/main/java/io/netty/channel/udt/nio/NioUdtByteConnectorChannel.java#L198) as `NioUdtByteConnectorChannel`.

It has a `bind` method with an identical signature. But it was compiled for java 6.

issue.title: AbstractMethodError with barchart-udt (builded for java 6)

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
Motivation:

`SocketChannelUDT` from barchart-udt does not have the java 7 `public abstract SocketChannel bind(SocketAddress local)` method. Calling the abstract method `SocketChannel.bind(SocketAddress localAddress)` for `SocketChannelUDT` leads to an `AbstractMethodError` runtime error.

Modifications:

Make workaround with explicit call of `SocketChannelUDT.bind(SocketAddress local)` as it done in `NioUdtByteConnectorChannel`.

Result:

Fixes [#6934].
